settings.playback.deck_press.copy: Open details shows the movie or episode page when you press OK on a Continue Watching card. Play starts or resumes it at once. The card's menu, opened by holding OK, always has the other.
settings.playback.skip_interval.copy: How far one press of Left or Right jumps in the player.
settings.audio.foreign: When audio isn't in the subtitle language
settings.audio.foreign.short: When audio isn't in the subtitle language
settings.audio.selection_off: Automatic selection is off. Choosing a language enables it.
settings.audio.sign_in_again: Sign in to this Plex profile again to edit its account preferences.
settings.playback.save_failed: Could not save or load this preference. Please try again.
settings.plaintext.question: Connect without encryption?
settings.plaintext.body: Your Plex sign-in will travel without encryption over this network, to this server only.
settings.plaintext.connected: Allowed on this network. Connected without encryption.
settings.plaintext.allowed: Allowed on this network when a secure connection fails.
settings.login.report_question: Send a report about this sign-in problem?
settings.login.report_body: The report says which sign-in step failed and how the connection answered, storage failure stages and error numbers, plus the app version. It never includes your account name, tokens, PIN, sign-in code or network addresses.
settings.login.unreachable: Can’t reach Plex. Check your TV’s internet connection.
settings.login.report_saved: Report saved. It will be sent later.
settings.login.save_failed_body: Your sign-in couldn’t be saved on this TV. You can continue, but you’ll be asked to sign in again next time.
settings.legal.privacy.plaintext_body: For a server you were asked about, PlxNative also keeps whether you allowed an unencrypted connection on your home network, for the Plex account that answered. Only the answer is stored. The permission itself is never stored and ends when a fresh check no longer reaches the same server address, at sign-in or sign-out, at a profile switch unless the new profile reaches that server at the same address, or when the app returns from the background.
